title: Research Meshtastic portduino SimRadio C++ interface and build system requirements
description:
Research the Meshtastic portduino architecture to understand how to implement a custom SimRadio backend.

Key areas to investigate:

1. **RadioInterface abstraction**
   - Locate the base RadioInterface class in portduino
   - Identify required virtual methods: startReceive(), startTransmit(), getPacketLength(), etc.
   - Document the packet buffer format and metadata fields

2. **Existing SimRadio implementations**
   - Check if portduino has any simulated radio for testing
   - Study RadioLibInterface as the hardware radio reference
   - Note callback patterns for TX complete, RX available

3. **Build system**
   - How portduino builds on Linux (CMake? PlatformIO?)
   - Required dependencies and toolchain
   - How to add a new radio backend without forking core

4. **Position/GPS integration**
   - How Meshtastic handles position packets
   - Whether GPS can be injected programmatically for simulation
   - Mapping x/y/z coordinates to lat/lon/alt

Deliverable: Summary document in docs/ with interface signatures and build instructions.
